I have all the records I need. Let me analyze:

**PO-2026-0090** ordered 1 × Mesin Kopi Otomatis and 19 × Teh Celup. The only goods receipt, **GR-2026-0090** (2026-09-30), recorded just **11 × Teh Celup** — no coffee machine at all. `get_billing_position` confirms `value_received_with_tax` = 467,643 (11 tea × 38,300 × 1.11 tax) versus `this_invoice_total` 7,718,163, with `within_received: false` and `invoiced_before: []`.

So the invoice bills the full ordered quantity while only part of the goods was delivered, and nothing was invoiced before on this PO. That is a short delivery, not a resubmission (no earlier invoice exists on this PO) and not a separate later delivery (invoicing is not within received).
